[quote=norrhollow;58814166][b]The Shamat Gambit | [sub]Covert | 17 March 2025[/sub][/b]

A certain phone call was made and a certain gentleman's agreement had been reached.

In the great blue skies of Erene, a lone black transport aircraft was seen, quietly enveloped in a blanket of great clouds. It was no passenger plane but a turbopop military airlift, officially designated as the Springflame-4A. While unmarked to avoid the scrutiny of international powers, the aircraft was a corporate unit of SummitONE Solutions, a shadowy private military company and subsidiary of Norrhollow's Almstedt Corporation.

After flying over the featureless Baliwick Sea for hours on end, the Springflame would pass over the southwestern peninsula of West Shamat, passing by Imperio Joanesko and Chechnya and finally reaching Sal-Baliz. A lone white light would be shone over the airport at Aduab to signal the aircraft's friendly intentions.

The plane would land on the asphalt without incident, then shutting down. The door of the Springflame opens, and men in heavy military gear would walk out, covered head-to-toe as if to obscure their identities, though in the midst of it a clear label would be clearly marked on their body armor, proudly displaying their corporate allegiance:

SummitONE Solutions.

[nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation][/quote]

A team of 10 Sal-Baliz fighters were sent to escort them from the airport -which is really just a collection of dusty runways, built by the Sal-Baliz 20 years ago- to the Tazir Al Shinwar compound, just east of Aduab, where supreme leader Falah Madhir was waiting. They all climbed into the back of a several military jeeps, which sped through the cities winding streets.

[quote=sal-baliz;58814384]A team of 10 Sal-Baliz fighters were sent to escort them from the airport -which is really just a collection of dusty runways, built by the Sal-Baliz 20 years ago- to the Tazir Al Shinwar compound, just east of Aduab, where supreme leader Falah Madhir was waiting. They all climbed into the back of a several military jeeps, which sped through the cities winding streets.[/quote]
Three figures would be easily singled out from among the SummitONE operatives boarding the jeeps, all wearing what seemed to be lanyards indicating some degree of seniority within SummitONE's corporate hierarchy. All others were evidently military contractors, having been assigned to Sal-Baliz either as escorts or as part of their first envisioned contract with the Balizians.

Upon reaching Tazir Al Shinwar, the three figures would each carefully step out of the jeep, wordlessly nodding to each other as they allow the escorts to guide them further in.

"Well, about as fancy an introduction as you can get, honestly." The first of the three figures would take off his helmet and face coverings, revealing his long, brown hair and trademark blue eyes typical of the Norrhollower people. Reaching into his body armor, the man took out a pair of glasses, which he would put on to get a better look at the supreme leader. 

"Good day to you, Mr. Madhir." The man reached out his hand for a shake, grinning widely from ear to ear. "I'm Xavier Almstedt, President of the Almstedt Corporation and SummitONE Solutions. I'm delighted to be here today in front of your... amenable countrymen..."

[b]Hochdeutsch Kaiserliche Kriegskommand  Offizieller Bericht zur Situation im Westlichen Ozean

Imperial War Command  Official Report on the Situation in the Western Ocean  EKOM

 3:49 PM Western Elseyr Time [/b]

[i]A combat mission group consisting of four [b]F-15 fighter jets[/b] from the [b]Kaiserliche Luftstreitkräfte[/b] (Imperial Air Force) and thirty-two Reichsadler Collaborative Combat Aircraft (RCCA) conducted a military training exercise over the [b]Westlichen Ozean[/b]. During the exercise, the fighter jets [b]breached the British Republics airspace more than seven times[/b], accumulating a total incursion time of five hours before returning to Neudresden Kriegskommand Base. Shortly afterward, Surface Action Group V of the Kaiserliche Marine [b]entered the British Republics territorial waters[/b], where it has since remained. According to sources familiar with the situation, all personnel on leave at EKOM (Elseyr Kommand) have been recalled to duty. The [b]Verteidigungszustand[/b] (defense condition) of the Reichswehr has been raised to Alarmstufe. At this time, neither the [b]Ministry for Foreign Affairs[/b] nor the [b]Kaiserliche Kriegskommand[/b] has issued an official statement regarding the military exercises conducted on Sunday or the continued naval presence in British waters.[/i]

[i][u][b]Democratic Federation of [nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation] shifted to non-reduced electric cars in 2030[/b]
[/u]
The Democratic Federation of [nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation] has started to shift to non-reduced electric cars at the end of 2030. The goal is to cut down gas and oil use in the nations by focusing more on non-reduce options. Prime Minister, Banyu Deniz Ail of the Democratic Federation of Indonocaismnic issues for more renewable energy. At the end of 2030, the Democratic Federation of [nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation] will transform towards sustainability by fully replacing it with non-reductive electric vehicles. This shift aims to focus on reducing fossil fuel dependence, particularly gas and oil, by replacing renewable, eco-friendly transportation options as well as including power plants and solar farms.

Prime Minister Banyu Deniz Ail has emphasized the critical importance of expanding renewable energy sources to power and ensuring that the nations infrastructure supports cleaner, greener alternatives. The Federations commitment to reducing its carbon footprint with global efforts to combat climate change and create a more sustainable future for generations to come in Indonocaismnic. As well as planned to build the first-speed electronic railway in the southern part of Indonocaismnic. With a cost of 55 Billion in US currency at the end of 2031 to support non-renewable transport. Prime Minister Banyu Deniz Ail has called for other foreign investments to help with the project plan for 2030 and welcomes any investment. [/i]
